description: Clears every thread older than a cutoff at once, as the inbox's bulk Clear does (owner or admin seats only): mode date clears threads quiet for olderThanDays (default 14) or since cutoff (ISO date); mode leads clears threads a lead follow-up owns. includeTasks also closes their open tasks; includeReplyOwed also clears threads the customer wrote last in (date mode). The Quo inbox follows when the business's write setting allows. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: bulk_clear_conversations
title: Clear old conversations in bulk
